title.en: A Density-Matrix Belief-State World Model
title.zh: 密度矩阵信念态世界模型

en: A programme within Omytea studying density-matrix belief states as representations of uncertainty over multiple futures. The work uses classically executed open-system mathematics, operator/channel updates and records of how observations revise a forecast.

Current prototypes study calibration and auditable updates. They do not establish forecasting superiority or quantum-computing advantage. Related work includes the Personal Future Console and a Python package for density-matrix and Lindblad-style calculations.
zh: Omytea 预测研究中的一个方向，以密度矩阵信念态表达多种未来的不确定性，使用经典计算实现的开系统数学、算子／信道更新，并记录观测如何修正预测。
目前的原型研究校准与可追溯更新，尚未建立预测优势或量子计算优势。相关工作包括个人未来控制台，以及用于密度矩阵和 Lindblad 形式计算的 Python 软件包。

title.en: What an Algorithmic-Idealism Modular Identification Requires: A Foundational Delimitation
title.zh: 算法理想主义的模块化识别需要什么:一个基础性界定

en: Examines the assumptions required for modular identification in an observer-state framework, separating a formal mathematical correspondence from claims about physical interpretation.
Part of the observer-state research programme. The current manuscript remains exploratory; its hypotheses and interpretation are not a completed empirical theory.
zh: 考察观察者态框架中模块化识别所需的假设，区分形式数学对应与物理解释主张。
属于观察者态研究计划，目前仍是探索性手稿；其中的假设与解释尚未构成经验证的完整物理理论。

title.en: The Universal Prior Does Not Select a Factorization
title.zh: 通用先验不选出分解

en: An earlier observer-state manuscript examining whether an algorithmic prior can select a tensor factorization and what additional locality assumptions are needed.

The public descendant appeared in July 2026. Later work treats restricted finite-register and machine-dependent ranking questions; the earlier broad formulation is retained as research history, not a universal conclusion about Born-rule derivations.
zh: 观察者态研究中的早期手稿，考察算法先验能否选择张量分解，以及需要补充哪些局域性假设。
其公开后续版本于 2026 年 7 月出现。较新的研究处理有限寄存器与机器相关排序问题；早期的宽泛表述作为研究脉络保留，不作为对所有玻恩规则推导的普遍结论。

title.en: A Universal Prior Cannot by Itself Select a Preferred Factorization: A Bounded-Alphabet Locality No-Go, with a Route-by-Route Map of the Same Gap in Born-Rule Derivations
title.zh: 通用先验自身无法选出优先分解:有界字母表下的局域性不可行定理,及同一缺口在玻恩规则推导中的逐路线映射

status.zh: 公开预印本 · 2026 年 7 月

en: A public descendant of the observer-state locality programme. It examines bounded-alphabet recodings and the structural assumptions behind a preferred factorization, with a route-by-route discussion of Born-rule arguments.

The historical public title is retained. Subsequent finite-register work narrows the question to explicit representations and conditional description-length comparisons; the preprint is not evidence that every Born-rule derivation fails.
zh: 观察者态局域性研究的公开后续版本，讨论有界字母表重编码、优先分解的结构假设，以及不同玻恩规则论证中的相关前提。
保留公开版本的历史标题。后续有限寄存器研究将问题收窄到明确表示与有条件的描述长度比较；该预印本并不证明所有玻恩规则推导均失败。

title.en: Boltzmann Brains under an Observer-State Ontology
title.zh: 观察者态本体论下的玻尔兹曼大脑

en: Re-examines measure, typicality and self-locating evidence in the Boltzmann-brain problem within an observer-state framework.
Part of the wider observer-state research programme, with later manuscript development kept separate from the original research period.
zh: 在观察者态框架中重新讨论玻尔兹曼大脑问题中的测度、典型性与自定位证据。
属于更广泛的观察者态研究计划，后续手稿整理与原研究时间分别记录。

title.en: Other Minds under an Observer-State Ontology
title.zh: 观察者态本体论下的他心问题

en: Studies what assumptions a single-observer description needs to support claims about other observers and shared observations. Multi-observer consistency remains a question to be established.
Part of the wider observer-state research programme, with later manuscript development kept separate from the original research period.
zh: 研究单观察者描述在讨论其他观察者与共享观测时需要哪些假设；多观察者一致性仍是待建立的问题。
属于更广泛的观察者态研究计划，后续手稿整理与原研究时间分别记录。

title.en: Convergence of local modular data for half-line free fermions and a locality/passband obstruction to raw fixed-cutoff global quasi-equivalence
title.zh: 半直线自由费米子局域模数据的收敛，以及原始固定截断全局拟等价的局域性／通带障碍

status.zh: 公开预印本 · 第二版，2026 年 7 月 31 日

en: Studies the continuum limit of finite-dimensional modular data for half-line free fermions using compact-local wavelet schemes. Under the stated hypotheses, local restrictions converge in norm and the modular generators converge in the strong-resolvent sense after faithful block completion.

A locality/passband obstruction distinguishes local convergence from raw fixed-cutoff global quasi-equivalence. Version 2 corrects the earlier endpoint-rate discussion; current external journal-review status is not asserted.
zh: 利用紧支撑局域小波格式研究半直线自由费米子有限维模数据的连续极限。在给定假设下，局域限制按范数收敛，忠实分块补全后的模生成元按强预解式意义收敛。
局域性／通带障碍区分了局域收敛与原始固定截断下的全局拟等价。第二版修正了早期端点速率讨论；此处不主张当前已进入期刊外审。

title.en: Coherent Strange-Current Contributions to X(2370) → ηηη
title.zh: X(2370) → ηηη 中的相干奇异流贡献

status.zh: 已投稿手稿 · Physica Scripta，2026 年 10 月

en: Analyses coherent strange-current contributions to X(2370) → ηηη, tracking amplitudes, interference and phase-space factors rather than replacing the coherent sum with separate rates.

At the stated reference inputs, the light and strange amplitudes interfere destructively; the completed ηηη width is smaller by a factor of approximately 30.88. The charge-complete reference ratio Γ(ηηη)/Γ(KKπ) is approximately 3.315 × 10⁻⁴. The sensitivity box contains a cancellation region; this is a conditional channel prediction, not a measurement of glueball composition.

Related earlier work examined two-photon production and Belle constraints. Amplitude ambiguity prevented the proposed broad-family limit; that study is retained as an archived negative result, distinct from the submitted strange-current manuscript.
zh: 分析 X(2370) → ηηη 中的相干奇异流贡献，显式追踪振幅、干涉与相空间因子，而非将相干和替换为独立衰变率之和。
在给定参考输入下，轻夸克与奇异夸克振幅发生破坏性干涉，补全后的 ηηη 衰变宽度减小约 30.88 倍。计入完整电荷道的参考比值 Γ(ηηη)/Γ(KKπ) 约为 3.315 × 10⁻⁴。敏感性参数区域包含抵消情形；这是有条件的道预测，不是对胶球成分的测量。
较早的相关工作考察双光子产生与 Belle 约束。振幅歧义使原拟议的广泛模型族限制无法成立；该研究作为归档负结果保留，与已投稿的奇异流手稿分开。

title.en: Digit Dependence under Translation-Conjugated Cyclic Rotation
title.zh: 平移共轭循环旋转的数位依赖

en: Studies how translation-conjugated cyclic rotation changes the dependence of output digits on input digits. The manuscript constructs a complete pivotality matrix under an explicit finite-register model.

The analysis relates dependence to carry structure and establishes a bounded-fan-in circuit-depth result within the stated model. Finite enumerations check examples; they are not substituted for the general argument.
zh: 研究平移共轭循环旋转如何改变输出数位对输入数位的依赖，并在明确的有限寄存器模型中构造完整关键性矩阵。
分析将依赖关系与进位结构联系起来，并在给定模型内研究有界扇入电路深度。有限枚举用于核查实例，不替代一般论证。

title.en: Born Rule & Naturalness
title.zh: 玻恩规则与自然性

en: An exploratory direction on Born-rule naturalness, representation choices and the assumptions connecting observer-state mathematics to physical probabilities.
The direction is paused; no completed derivation of the Born rule or resolution of the interpretation problem is claimed.
zh: 围绕玻恩规则自然性、表示选择，以及观察者态数学与物理概率之间所需假设开展的探索。
该方向目前暂停，不主张已完成玻恩规则推导或解决量子解释问题。

title.en: Calibration diagnostics for ringdown overtone tests
title.zh: 铃宕泛音检验的校准诊断

status.zh: 工作手稿 · 分析进行中

en: Studies how start time, conditioning, processing choices and null calibration affect the significance assigned to a black-hole ringdown overtone. The programme began in June 2024; the computations described here were carried out in 2026.

A controlled synthetic Gaussian-mixture null study used 199 calibration and 200 test samples. The conditioned test rejected 10/200 null samples (5%; 95% binomial interval 2.42–9.00%). This bounded synthetic diagnostic does not establish coverage in real detector noise.

Related work compares waveform and posterior conventions, including a separate GW250114 posterior audit. The illustration below is an explanatory visualization, not a new detector observation or event-discovery result.
zh: 研究起始时刻、条件化、处理选择与零假设校准如何影响黑洞铃宕泛音的显著性。研究计划始于 2024 年 6 月，此处所述计算在 2026 年完成。
受控的合成高斯混合零假设研究使用 199 个校准样本与 200 个测试样本。条件化检验拒绝了其中 10/200 个样本（5%；95% 二项区间 2.42–9.00%）。这一有限合成诊断尚不能建立真实探测器噪声中的覆盖率。
相关工作比较波形与后验约定，并包含独立的 GW250114 后验审计。下方图示用于解释方法，不是新的探测器观测或事件发现。

title.en: Strongly supercooled transition dynamics and tachyonic modes
title.zh: 强过冷相变动力学与快子模式

where.zh: 粒子理论与相变动力学

status.zh: 未发表的计算与理论研究

en: Studies strongly supercooled transition dynamics using an RG-improved potential, an O(4) bounce, Euclidean initialization of fluctuations and subsequent mode evolution in Milne coordinates. Original research dates to September 2025; the documented comparison was performed on 16 October 2026.

Four conditional trajectories compare the numerical evolution under specific initialization and backreaction assumptions. Shooting/collocation agreement and equation residuals check bounded numerical steps; physical-consistency questions concerning the vacuum and Ward constraints remain open.

Related studies address spillway-preheating inverse problems, typed tachyon representations, order parameters and finite-window phase-boundary criteria. These are narrower working lines, not a universal completed classification or an independently established new phase transition.
zh: 利用重整化群改进势、O(4) 反弹解、涨落的欧氏初始化，以及 Milne 坐标下的模式演化研究强过冷相变动力学。原研究时间为 2025 年 9 月，所记录的比较于 2026 年 10 月 16 日进行。
四条有条件轨迹比较了特定初始化与反作用假设下的数值演化。打靶法／配点法的一致性与方程残差用于核查有限数值步骤；真空与 Ward 约束等物理一致性问题仍未闭合。
相关研究涉及 spillway 预热逆问题、带类型的快子表示、序参量与有限窗口相边界判据。这些是范围较窄的工作方向，不是普遍完成的分类或已独立确立的新相变。

title.en: Population-feature significance and finite selection simulations
title.zh: 族群特征显著性与有限选择模拟

en: Audits finite-injection uncertainty for population-feature claims in GWTC-4, relating catalogue events, selection simulations and feature-local effective sample size.

The proposed explanation based on severe local underconvergence was not supported by the diagnostic. The work also studies bounded finite-selection null simulations; it does not establish a universal distribution-free significance certificate.
zh: 针对 GWTC-4 族群特征主张审计有限注入样本的不确定性，联系事件目录、选择模拟与特征局域有效样本量。
基于严重局域欠收敛的拟议解释未获该诊断支持。研究也考察有限选择的零假设模拟，不主张普遍的分布无关显著性证书。

title.en: CMS Jet Physics
title.zh: CMS 喷流物理

en: Graduate research on CMS jet physics using PYTHIA simulations to study parton-shower cascades and jet structure.

Examined how jet topology and simulation choices inform the interpretation of beyond-the-Standard-Model signatures. This experience concerns simulation and analysis, without a claim of a current CMS appointment or detector-operation role.
zh: 在布朗大学 Roloff 组从事 CMS 喷流物理研究，使用 PYTHIA 模拟分析部分子淋浴级联与喷流结构。
考察喷流拓扑与模拟选择如何影响对超出标准模型信号的解释。该经历属于模拟与分析，不表示当前 CMS 任职或探测器运行职责。

title.en: Unified Theory for 3ω Thermal Characterization: Finite Heater Length and Environmental Coupling
title.zh: 3ω 热学表征的统一理论:有限加热丝长度与环境耦合

en: Participated in thermal-transport research on carbon-nanotube 3ω characterization and finite-heater impedance modelling.

The work considers heater length, environmental coupling, heater heat capacity and boundary resistance across vacuum, fluid and supported configurations. Participation in the research and manuscript work is distinct from confirmed public-paper authorship.
zh: 参与碳纳米管 3ω 热学表征与有限加热丝阻抗建模的热输运研究。
研究考虑真空、流体及衬底环境下的加热丝长度、环境耦合、加热丝热容与界面热阻。研究及手稿参与经历与已确认的公开论文作者身份分别表述。

title.en: Formation Mechanism of Blazar Jets
title.zh: 耀变体喷流的形成机制

where.zh: 天体物理 · UCL 研究项目

en: A single-author study of blazar-jet formation, comparing jet power, accretion-disc luminosity and the physical mechanisms associated with Blandford–Payne and Blandford–Znajek models.
Published in Theoretical and Natural Science, volume 19, pages 169–175 (2023).
zh: 单作者耀变体喷流形成研究，比较喷流功率、吸积盘光度，以及 Blandford–Payne 和 Blandford–Znajek 模型对应的物理机制。
发表于 Theoretical and Natural Science，第 19 卷，169–175 页（2023 年）。

title.en: In-Beam γ-ray Spectroscopy
title.zh: 在束 γ 射线能谱学

en: Analysed in-beam γ-ray spectra from α-induced nuclear reactions, using energy-matrix gates to distinguish coincidence structures and identify residual nuclides.
The experience focused on spectral interpretation and nuclide identification; a separate accelerator visit is not presented as conducting an irradiation experiment.
zh: 分析 α 粒子诱发核反应的在束 γ 能谱，通过能量矩阵开窗区分符合结构并鉴别剩余核素。
经历重点为能谱解释与核素鉴别；另行参加的加速器参观不表述为开展辐照实验。

title.en: Axion-Like Dark Matter
title.zh: 类轴子暗物质

where.zh: 暗物质现象学 · 北京师范大学

en: Studied axion-like dark-matter phenomenology through photon survival probabilities and their dependence on candidate-particle parameters.
The project developed parameter-space interpretation rather than a new experimental exclusion limit.
zh: 通过光子生存概率及其对候选粒子参数的依赖，研究类轴子暗物质现象学。
项目涉及参数空间解释，不主张提出新的实验排除限。

title.en: MAXI J1348-630 Black-Hole X-ray Binary
title.zh: MAXI J1348-630 黑洞 X 射线双星

where.zh: X 射线天体物理 · 山东大学

en: Undergraduate thesis on MAXI J1348-630 using public NICER and NuSTAR observations. The analysis used HEASoft/NuSTARDAS, source/background extraction and NuSTAR FPMA/FPMB products.

Timing work used Powspec, while spectral analysis used XSPEC and model-residual comparisons. The examined NuSTAR data did not yield a useful QPO identification; fitting residuals and model limitations remained part of the interpretation.
zh: 利用公开 NICER 与 NuSTAR 观测研究 MAXI J1348-630 的本科毕业论文。分析使用 HEASoft／NuSTARDAS、源区与背景提取，以及 NuSTAR FPMA／FPMB 数据产品。
计时分析使用 Powspec，能谱分析使用 XSPEC 并比较模型残差。所检视的 NuSTAR 数据未给出可用的 QPO 识别；拟合残差与模型局限保留在结果解释中。

title.en: TOI Stellar-Flare Spectroscopy
title.zh: TOI 恒星耀发光谱

where.zh: 恒星光谱 · 山东大学

en: Studied TOI stellar-flare spectroscopy and the interpretation of time-dependent stellar activity.
Connected flare spectral behaviour to planetary radiation environments and habitability questions, with the observational and interpretive scope stated separately.
zh: 研究 TOI 恒星耀发光谱及随时间变化的恒星活动解释。
联系耀发光谱行为、行星辐射环境与宜居性问题，并区分观测内容与解释范围。

title.en: Inference Rent in Generative AI: Intellectual Monopoly and Metered Access to Non-Rival Capability
title.zh: 生成式 AI 中的推理租金：知识垄断与非竞争性能力的计量访问

status.zh: 公开 SSRN 预印本 · 2026 年 9 月修订

en: Develops inference rent as a category for analysing metered access to generative-AI capability: an underlying non-rival capability is made available through priced inference and platform-controlled access.

Distinguishes technological capability, access conditions and the institutional power to collect rents. The September 2026 revision develops the earlier technological-monopoly-rent manuscript rather than constituting a separate new paper.
zh: 以推理租金分析对生成式 AI 能力的计量访问：底层非竞争性能力通过定价推理与平台控制的入口提供。
区分技术能力、访问条件与收取租金的制度性权力。2026 年 9 月修订版延续早期技术垄断租金手稿，不另计为一篇新论文。

title.en: Frontier AI and the Limits of Monopoly Self-Correction: Inference Rent, Compute Bottlenecks, and Platform Lock-In
title.zh: 前沿 AI 与垄断自我纠正的局限：推理租金、算力瓶颈与平台锁定

where.zh: 政治经济学与产业组织

en: Examines why frontier-AI markets may fail to correct concentrated power through ordinary competitive entry, connecting inference rent, compute bottlenecks and platform lock-in.
A conceptual political-economy paper, distinct from the documentary study of public AI-compute programmes. Its public-preprint status does not imply journal acceptance.
zh: 研究前沿 AI 市场为何可能无法通过通常的竞争进入纠正集中权力，联系推理租金、算力瓶颈与平台锁定。
这是概念性政治经济学论文，与公共 AI 算力计划的文献记录研究不同；公开预印本不表示期刊录用。

title.en: Camera, Player, Engine: An Epistemology for Writing About a System You Are Inside
title.zh: 相机、棋手、引擎：书写自身身处其中之系统的认识论

en: Develops a framework for writing about systems in which the writer is also a participant: observation, strategic participation and intervention create different epistemic demands.
The camera, player and engine distinguish descriptive distance, situated action and system-changing activity without treating any one stance as a neutral view from outside.
zh: 为书写作者自身也身处其中的系统建立框架：观测、策略性参与与干预带来不同的认识论要求。
以相机、棋手与引擎区分描述距离、情境行动与改变系统的活动，而不把任何一种位置视为系统之外的中立视角。

title.en: An Invitation After Abundance: Reading the Present, Wagering the Future
title.zh: An Invitation After Abundance:读现在,赌未来

where.zh: 政治经济学专著 · 1,162 页

en: A political-economy volume: reading the present and wagering the future — technology, power, and institutions after abundance.
A parallel original to the Chinese-language 和平请柬 — two independent works.
A parallel original work: the English and Chinese books are independently written, not translations of one another.
zh: 一部政治经济学专著:读现在,赌未来——富足之后的技术、权力与制度。
与中文专著《和平请柬》为两部平行的原创著作。
英中文两部著作为分别写作的平行原创作品，互不构成翻译。

title.en: 和平请柬
title.zh: 和平请柬

where.zh: 中文政治经济学专著 · 1,068 页

en: A Chinese-language monograph written as an invitation: at the threshold of leaving university, an attempt to read the age being entered and judge where it is going — productive capacity outrunning our institutional language, and the question of who pays for that gap.
A parallel original to An Invitation After Abundance — two independent works. Hardcover · ISBN 979-8-9960105-1-6.
A parallel original work: the English and Chinese books are independently written, not translations of one another.
zh: 一部以"请柬"为形式的中文专著:在即将离开大学、走入世界的门槛上,试图读懂将要进入的时代并判断它往哪里去——生产能力推进得太快、制度语言跟不上,这道差距由谁付账。
与《An Invitation After Abundance》为两部平行的原创著作。精装 · ISBN 979-8-9960105-1-6。
英中文两部著作为分别写作的平行原创作品，互不构成翻译。

title.en: Sovereign Scintillation Over Grand Fluctuation: An Observer-State Theory of Physics
title.zh: Sovereign Scintillation Over Grand Fluctuation:观察者态物理理论

en: A single-volume framework: observer self-states plus a universal-prior-weighted transition rule as primitives, asking what physics — locality, modular flow, the Born rule — does and does not follow.
zh: 单卷本框架专著:以观察者自态与通用先验加权的转移规则为原语,追问物理——局域性、模流、玻恩规则——什么能从中导出,什么不能。

title.en: The Well: scientific-simulation evaluation
title.zh: The Well：科学模拟评估

status.en: Working research and merged software contributions
status.zh: 研究进行中；软件贡献已合入

en: Studies denominator sensitivity in normalized rollout metrics, physical-unit error comparisons and the inverse problem of identifying active-matter dynamics from aggregate observations.

Software contributions address epsilon propagation in VRMSE/VMSE (#92, merged 23 July 2026) and long-horizon batch averaging (#93, merged 12 October 2026). AI-assisted development is disclosed. A merged fix is distinct from a released package or a benchmark-performance claim.
zh: 研究归一化 rollout 指标对分母的敏感性、物理单位下的误差比较，以及从聚合观测识别活性物质动力学的逆问题。
软件贡献处理 VRMSE／VMSE 中的 epsilon 传递（#92，2026 年 7 月 23 日合入）与长时域批次平均（#93，2026 年 10 月 12 日合入），并披露 AI 辅助开发。代码合入不等同于已发布软件包或基准性能优势。

title.en: Language-model calibration and statistical identification
title.zh: 语言模型校准与统计识别

status.zh: 未发表的实证与理论研究

en: An empirical line examines whether hidden representations add information about correctness beyond output-based baselines. A Qwen2.5-0.5B / ARC-Challenge pilot evaluated 1,165 held-out test questions. The AUROC increment was 0.00218, with a paired-bootstrap 95% interval of −0.01857 to 0.02283: no clear improvement in that configuration.

A distinct mathematical line studies finite exchangeability, deletion models, expected-correctness summaries and statistical identification. It distinguishes what full observations identify from what rank or aggregate summaries retain, including examples of positive population ambiguity. These draft results are not journal acceptances or a general negative claim about model internals.
zh: 实证方向考察隐藏表示能否在输出基线之外提供正确性信息。Qwen2.5-0.5B／ARC-Challenge 试验评估 1,165 个留出测试问题，AUROC 增量为 0.00218，配对 bootstrap 95% 区间为 −0.01857 至 0.02283：在该配置中未观察到明确改进。
另一个数学方向研究有限可交换性、删除模型、期望正确性摘要与统计识别，区分完整观测与排序／聚合摘要保留的信息，并研究正人口歧义实例。这些工作手稿不表示期刊录用，也不构成对模型内部表示的一般否定。

title.en: What Public AI Compute Records Can Establish: Evidence, Access and Comparison
title.zh: 公共 AI 算力记录能够确立什么：证据、访问与比较

where.zh: 技术政策与文献记录研究

status.zh: 已投稿手稿 · IJTPM，2026 年 10 月

en: A bounded documentary study of six public AI-compute programmes, asking what published records can establish about access, allocation and comparison.

The analysis separates programme-level announcements, accounting units, tariffs and evidence for named-project consumption. It does not infer confidential usage, causal policy failure or the absence of activity beyond the documentary frame. Last verified journal stage: screening.
zh: 对六个公共 AI 算力计划开展范围明确的文献记录研究，考察公开材料能为访问、分配与比较建立哪些证据。
区分计划公告、核算单位、费率与具名项目消耗的证据；不推断保密使用情况、因果性的政策失败或文献框架之外不存在活动。最近核实的期刊阶段为初筛。

title.en: GW250114: posterior conventions and exclusion diagnostics
title.zh: GW250114：后验约定与排除诊断

en: Compares seven public GW250114 posterior sets, examining start-time choices, amplitude conventions and how these enter simplified overtone-exclusion calculations.

Simplified exclusions span 0.91σ–3.45σ under the examined choices. This is a posterior-convention audit within the ringdown programme, not a complete new parameter-estimation analysis or a discovery claim.
zh: 比较七组公开 GW250114 后验，考察起始时刻、振幅约定及其如何进入简化的泛音排除计算。
在所考察选择下，简化排除显著性为 0.91σ–3.45σ。这是铃宕计划中的后验约定审计，不是完整的新参数估计分析或发现主张。

title.en: Finite-register locality and machine-dependent ranking
title.zh: 有限寄存器局域性与机器相关排序

en: Studies explicit finite-register representations, locality, short descriptions and the dependence of representation rankings on the chosen machine.

The claims concern conditional description-length comparisons and specified ranking constructions. They do not establish an impossibility theorem for every universal prior or a universal disproof of Born-rule derivations. Related work derives the digit-dependence structure of translation-conjugated cyclic rotation.
zh: 研究明确的有限寄存器表示、局域性、短描述，以及表示排序对所选机器的依赖。
主张限于有条件的描述长度比较与给定排序构造，不建立针对所有通用先验的不可行定理，也不普遍否定玻恩规则推导。相关工作研究平移共轭循环旋转的数位依赖结构。
